mine: you (God) have increased its (the nation's) joy
note: The ketiv lo' "not" gives the KJV's self-contradictory "multiplied the nation and not increased the joy"; the qere lo "to it" gives "increased its joy", which the rest of the verse requires.

kjv: every battle of the warrior [is] with confused noise ... but [this] shall be with burning (KJV 9:5)
mine: every boot of the trampling warrior ... will be burned as fuel
note: Hebrew se'on (hapax, Akkadian shenu "shoe") is a soldier's boot; the verse says battle gear will be burned, not that this battle will be by fire.
Hebrew pele' yo'ets is a construct pair, "a wonder of a counselor", like the other three two-word titles; the KJV comma yields five names.
